functions.name: claim_daily
functions.doc: A player of a closed day that met its target claims their share of the daily mint once.

functions.name: claim_starter
functions.doc:
One free starter amount per account, paid from the treasury. Registers the caller if
 needed, with the contract paying the storage. Anyone with many accounts can farm this:
 the treasury is the only limit.

functions.name: close_day
functions.doc:
Anyone. Closes a finished UTC day once. Target met: the day's players claim the daily
 mint, members of the day's top clan `clan_top_weight` shares each and everyone else one,
 so the claims add up to the daily mint (less indivisible dust). Target missed: a share of
 the treasury burns.

functions.name: collect_blinds
functions.doc:
Anyone. Moves the blind an idle holder owes into the treasury now. Blinds are also
 collected automatically before any change to that holder's balance.

assert!("ƒelicia.near".parse::<AccountId>().is_err()); // (ƒ is not f) ```

functions.name: compute_commitment
functions.doc:
The commitment to submit for a pick. A convenience: compute it off chain in production
 so the pick never leaves the player's device before the reveal.

functions.name: create_clan
functions.doc:
Founds a clan and makes the caller its first member. Burns `clan_create_burn` CHIP from
 the caller, which also keeps clan names from being squatted for free.

functions.name: ft_balance_of
functions.doc:
For holders, the balance after any blind owed now. For the contract account, the
 treasury plus the stakes at tables, which only the rules can move.

functions.name: get_tables
functions.doc: Newest first. `before` is exclusive.

functions.name: join_clan
functions.doc: Joins a clan. An account is in at most one clan at a time.

functions.name: join_table
functions.doc: Takes a seat at an open table with the table's stake and a commitment to a pick.

functions.name: leave_clan
functions.doc:
Leaves the caller's clan. A clan left with no members keeps its name. A player's clan for
 a day that has already started counting is not changed.

functions.name: lock_table
functions.doc: The host may start early once at least two seats are taken.

functions.name: new
functions.doc:
Deploy-time setup. Callable once, by the contract account itself.

 `treasury_supply` is minted into the treasury. `house_bankroll` is minted to the House,
 which plays as an ordinary account and can go broke.

functions.name: open_table
functions.doc: Opens a table and seats the caller with their stake and commitment.

functions.name: settle_round
functions.doc:
Settler only. Reports end prices in seat order, then burns the pot share, pays the
 winners and counts the table toward today's call. All in this one call.

functions.name: start_round
functions.doc:
Settler only. Reveals every pick with its start price, in seat order. Each reveal must
 match the commitment the player made when taking the seat.

Config.description: Rules fixed at deploy. There is no method that changes them.

clan_create_burn.description: CHIP burned from the founder's balance to found a clan.

clan_top_weight.description: Shares of the daily mint a member of the day's top clan claims; everyone else claims one.

daily_mint.description: Minted and shared equally between the day's players when the target is met.

daily_miss_burn_bps.description: Share of the treasury burned when a day misses its target.

daily_target_tables.description: Settled tables a UTC day needs for the daily mint.

pot_burn_bps.description: Share of every settled pot that is burned.

settler.description: The only account that may reveal picks and report prices.

starter_amount.description: Paid once to each account from the treasury by `claim_starter`.

clan.description: The account's clan for that day, fixed at its first settled table of the day.

share.description: One share of the daily mint: what a player outside the top clan claims.

top_clan.description: The clan with the most settled tables that day. On a tie, the clan that reached the count first keeps the lead (within one table, the clan of the earlier seat).

top_clan_players.description: Players whose clan for the day is the top clan. Set when the day closes.

top_share.description: What a member of the top clan claims: `share` times `clan_top_weight`.

balance.description: Balance after any blind owed now.

PriceReport.description: The settler's end price for one seat.
